text: {"memo": "Microsoft Corp (MSFT) delivered a solid FY2024 performance, posting revenue of $211.9\u202fB, up 6.8% from FY2023, and net income of $86.9\u202fB, a 10% improvement. EPS rose to $3.30, reflecting strong profitability across its three core segments. Operating income reached $108\u202fB, yielding an operating margin of roughly 51%, while net margin expanded to about 41%. Cash generation remained robust, with operating cash flow of $120\u202fB and free cash flow near $80\u202fB, supporting continued share buybacks and strategic investments. FY2023 had shown similar strength, with revenue of $198.3\u202fB, net income of $79.0\u202fB, EPS of $2.90, operating cash flow of $110\u202fB and free cash flow of $70\u202fB, indicating a consistent high‑margin model. The prior year, FY2022, posted revenue of $185.0\u202fB, net income of $69.0\u202fB, EPS of $2.60, operating cash flow of $100\u202fB and free cash flow of $60\u202fB, underscoring a multi\u2011year trend of double\u2011digit profit growth and margin expansion. Azure\u2019s cloud platform continued to drive high\u2011margin revenue, while Productivity & Business Processes and Gaming contributed stable cash flows. Overall, Microsoft’s FY2024 results reinforce its position as a leading technology leader with strong cash generation and scalable growth prospects. We maintain a buy rating on MSFT given its robust fundamentals and favorable outlook."}
